title: Morning Entry Routine
description: Students enter quietly, hang up belongings, complete morning work on desk

title: Attendance and Announcements
description: Take attendance using class list, read daily announcements, review schedule

title: Bathroom Transition
description: Students line up quietly by the door, walk in single file, return to seats when done

title: Recess Dismissal
description: Students clean up materials, line up by door, dismissed row by row to playground

title: Pre-Lunch Cleanup
description: Put away all materials, clean desk surface, stack chairs if needed

title: End of Day Dismissal
description: Pack up belongings, check homework agenda, line up for bus/pickup

title: Getting Attention Signal
description: Teacher raises hand, students raise hand and stop talking within 5 seconds

title: Noise Level Management
description: Use hand signals for voice levels: 0=silent, 1=whisper, 2=table talk, 3=presentation voice

title: Fire Drill Procedure
description: Stop work immediately, stand up, line up at door, follow teacher to designated exit and meeting area

title: Lockdown Procedure
description: Move away from windows and doors, sit quietly on floor, teacher locks door and turns off lights
